spec: DACS-2 VPA-1..VPA-10, PVC-1..PVC-6, PVPC-1..PVPC-11; DACS-3 provenanced ingress/check 10; DACS-5 ST-11/vetRecords projection
scope: Signed Vet provenance, fanout admission, agreement binding, and audit projection; assumes baseline DACS-1 Listing/PhaseStep schema validation and is not a complete outer AttestationBundle fixture
provenance: Deterministic in-repo generator; public Ed25519 test seeds; RFC 8785 JCS hashes; fixture strings are ASCII

representation.expandedHashScope: semantic vectors array with every patch expanded to its full input and representation-only members removed
representation.expandedInputHashScope: RFC 8785 JCS hash of each vector's fully expanded input

vectors.name: ordinary-bilateral-third-party-verifiers
vectors.note: One bilateral pair uses distinct signed requirements and independently selected third-party verifiers.

vectors.name: procurement-two-bidder-completed
vectors.note: Two all-pass supplier contexts produce four distinct records, an exact eligible set, winner/loser mappings, and retained publisher-for-loser provenance.

vectors.name: input-array-order-is-nonauthoritative
vectors.note: Invocation and context-keyed vetPairs input order may vary while canonical outputs and audit ordering remain unchanged.

vectors.name: procurement-conclusive-fail-excluded-and-retained
vectors.note: A conclusively failing second supplier is excluded before negotiation but all four of its authorization/record refs remain auditable.

vectors.name: bilateral-single-direction-fail-attributable
vectors.note: A sole counterparty-evaluation fail maps uniquely to the bilateral buyer fault.

vectors.name: partial-authorization-barrier-has-zero-verifier-effects
vectors.note: A partial authorization set aborts before method invocation, VerifyResult or Composite emission, eligibility, fault attribution, or reputation use.

vectors.name: partial-authorization-cannot-carry-composite-or-fault
vectors.note: A partial authorization set with verifier side effects, a Composite, and counterparty fault/reputation projection is not the permitted pre-barrier abort shape.

vectors.name: bilateral-both-directions-fail-not-single-fault
vectors.note: Different commerce parties fail the two directions; current faultedParty cannot choose one.

vectors.name: multi-candidate-prewinner-terminal-unrepresentable
vectors.note: The current outer bundle roles cannot represent a pre-agreement multi-candidate terminal.

vectors.name: accepted-listing-cannot-cross-preverification-gate
vectors.note: Unlike reversible authorization progression, the pinned Listing must already have a verified finalized anchor before any verification side effect.

vectors.name: accepted-authorization-not-final-at-st11
vectors.note: Accepted permits reversible verification, but ST-11 remains pending until finalized.

vectors.name: swapped-authorization-refs
vectors.note: Valid outer signatures cannot repair swapped role references.

vectors.name: swapped-authorization-requirement-hashes
vectors.note: Genuinely re-signed opposite-direction authorizations cannot swap their distinct requirement hashes.

vectors.name: authorization-requirement-body-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: The signed body changes while requirementHash stays pinned.

vectors.name: listing-requirement-substitution-validly-signed
vectors.note: Publisher signature does not permit replacing the exact signed Listing body.

vectors.name: wrong-party-authorizer
vectors.note: The evaluated bidder cannot self-authorize the Listing requirement.

vectors.name: unauthorized-verifier-substitution
vectors.note: A valid signature by an unselected verifier is unauthorized.

vectors.name: missing-verifier-identity
vectors.note: A signer ClaimReference alone does not preserve the selected verifier bundle.

vectors.name: invalid-verifier-presentation
vectors.note: The authorizer cannot validate a verifier IdentityBundle with an invalid control proof.

vectors.name: verifier-presentation-wrong-session-nonce
vectors.note: A valid verifier control proof from a different job-issued challenge is not the selected session verifier presentation.

vectors.name: evaluated-identity-body-substitution-replay
vectors.note: A valid, re-signed changed body no longer equals the admitted session bundle and cannot reuse its result.

vectors.name: evaluated-bundle-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: The signed evaluated body hash must recompute exactly.

vectors.name: missing-whole-bidder-pair
vectors.note: Shared roster count/hash detects omission of both directions for a bidder.

vectors.name: roster-count-disagreement
vectors.note: Every authorization must carry the same positive roster count and commitment.

vectors.name: cross-bidder-context-substitution
vectors.note: A candidate body cannot be moved under another candidate context.

vectors.name: authorization-wrong-logical-receipt
vectors.note: Native resolution does not excuse a receipt bound to the wrong logical tuple.

vectors.name: authorization-wrong-native-ref
vectors.note: AttestationRef locator must equal the authenticated receipt native address.

vectors.name: composite-wrong-logical-receipt
vectors.note: Composite receipt logical address must derive from its signed tuple.

vectors.name: composite-wrong-native-ref
vectors.note: Composite ref must resolve the receipt-authenticated native address.

vectors.name: authorization-ref-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: A Composite authorizationRef with a generic wrong content hash cannot resolve the signed authorization.

vectors.name: authorization-preimage-hash-is-not-anchor-content-hash
vectors.note: The VRA signature-preimage hash differs from and cannot replace the full signed anchored-content hash.

vectors.name: composite-preimage-hash-is-not-anchor-content-hash
vectors.note: The PCR signature-preimage hash differs from and cannot replace the full signed anchored-content hash.

vectors.name: authorization-both-discriminators
vectors.note: Both legacy and authorization discriminators are invalid.

vectors.name: composite-both-discriminators
vectors.note: Both provenanced and legacy Composite discriminators are invalid.

vectors.name: new-phase-cannot-use-legacy-composite
vectors.note: The signed new phase cannot downgrade to a legacy Composite.

vectors.name: legacy-phase-cannot-use-provenanced-record
vectors.note: A genuinely signed legacy-phase Listing cannot consume the new authorization or provenanced Composite types.

vectors.name: same-logical-address-different-content
vectors.note: Timestamp does not choose between different immutable bytes at one tuple address.

vectors.name: unvetted-winning-bidder
vectors.note: The agreement cannot omit its winner's exact counterparty record.

vectors.name: unvetted-losing-bidder
vectors.note: Every all-pass losing candidate needs its own exact record.

vectors.name: all-pass-loser-omitted-from-agreement
vectors.note: Agreement candidate contexts must equal the eligible set in both directions.

vectors.name: publisher-ref-bound-to-loser-context
vectors.note: The publisher's singular AgreementParty ref must use the winner context.

vectors.name: procurement-agreement-role-inversion
vectors.note: Publisher and winning supplier cannot use demand-mode seller/buyer roles.

vectors.name: signed-fail-cannot-be-admitted
vectors.note: A validly signed fail record remains audit evidence and cannot enter the eligible set.

vectors.name: retryable-error-bidder-cannot-be-silently-excluded

patch.value: declared assertion bytes unavailable to parser

vectors.note: A verifier/parser error follows its retry path and blocks phase admission rather than becoming bidder censorship.

vectors.name: vet-record-order-is-canonical
vectors.note: Scheduler or array order cannot alter the signed mixed-artifact list.

vectors.name: authorization-registry-pin-mismatch
vectors.note: Replay must use the exact signed session-start recipe registry pin.

vectors.name: publisher-body-differs-across-contexts
vectors.note: One publisher primary claim cannot hide different signed bodies across bidder contexts.

vectors.name: decision-errorclass-mismatch
vectors.note: A conclusive attributable fail cannot be relabelled as permanent self failure.

vectors.name: authorization-receipt-writer-proof-tamper
vectors.note: Changing the receipt-authenticated writer tuple without a new valid substrate proof fails; no equality with the artifact signer is implied.

vectors.name: composite-receipt-transaction-mismatch
vectors.note: The fixture proof and deterministic transaction tuple must bind the Composite.

vectors.name: authorization-receipt-nonce-mismatch
vectors.note: The applicable writer nonce is part of the immutable receipt tuple.

vectors.name: authorization-cross-domain-signature
vectors.note: Correct-key bytes over the PCR domain do not authenticate a VRA.

vectors.name: composite-cross-domain-signature
vectors.note: Correct-key bytes over the VRA domain do not authenticate a PCR.

vectors.name: cross-session-authorization-substitution
vectors.note: A genuine authorization for another job cannot enter this pinned session.

vectors.name: same-primary-different-session-bodies
vectors.note: Role-bearing addresses remain distinct, but opposite commerce parties must have distinct primary claims and cannot hide body equivocation.

vectors.name: expired-signed-listing-rejected
vectors.note: A genuine, fully relinked chain cannot use a Listing that is expired at the fixture session time.

vectors.name: unsupported-listing-major-version
vectors.note: A genuine, fully relinked Listing from an unsupported major version is rejected before provenance use.

vectors.name: authorization-boolean-count-is-not-an-integer
vectors.note: JSON true cannot satisfy the positive safe-integer counterpartyCount even in runtimes where booleans compare equal to one.

vectors.name: listing-publisher-session-party-mismatch
vectors.note: A genuine attacker-published Listing cannot be relinked to authorizations whose authenticated session publisher has a different presentedBy claim.

vectors.name: listing-missing-provenanced-vet-phase
vectors.note: A relinked Listing selecting only the legacy Vet phase cannot authorize the provenanced handler.

vectors.name: fixed-price-must-be-positive
vectors.note: A valid Listing signature and provenance chain do not make a non-positive fixed price conformant.

vectors.name: sealed-negotiate-session-context-job-mismatch
vectors.note: The sealed handoff's complete SessionContext must preserve the exact job, Listing tuple, registry pins, parties, prior Vet output, signer, and start time.

vectors.name: audit-phase-kind-mismatch
vectors.note: The audit projection must identify the provenanced phase whose records it retains.

vectors.name: agreement-party-bundle-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: Every projected AgreementParty hash must bind the exact authenticated publisher or counterparty bundle.
